verdict.rationale: Google Antigravity ships a first-party Agent SDK that exposes the same tools, agent loop, and context management as the product, programmable in Python. It supports custom callables, MCP servers, skills, and multimedia attachments. The evidence is only product-page marketing, covers a single language, and has no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: SDKs beyond Python, in-depth API reference/installation/versioning docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Agent SDK gives you the same tools, agent loop, and context management that power Google Antigravity, programmable in Python.
Layer custom Python callables, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and reusable agent skills over our built-in filesystem and terminal tools under a single pipeline.
Build AI agents that autonomously read files, run commands, edit code, and more.
